$description: h3nr7 design tokens. Mirrors assets/h3nr7.css, which mirrors h3nr7.com (packages/ui/src/styles/tokens.css). Named by role; colour values per theme.

surface.role: raised plane: cards, buttons at rest, dialogs

line.role: borders not meant to be noticed, link rail

display.stack: mrs-eaves, 'Mrs Eaves OT', 'Mrs Eaves', Baskerville, 'Libre Baskerville', 'Times New Roman', Times, serif
display.face: Mrs Eaves OT Italic (the only cut in use)
display.use: italic only, regular weight, ligatures always on: name, titles, statements, entry titles, monogram. Never tracked, never bold, no roman or small caps.
display.features: font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures discretionary-ligatures contextual (liga, clig, dlig, calt). liga: ff fi fl fb fh fj fr ft ffi ffl ffb ffh ffj ffr fft. dlig: ae ct ee fy gg gi gy ip it ky oe py sp st tt tw ty cky ggy tty ffy, AA AV FF FI FL HE LA MB MD ME MP NK NT OC OG OO TE TR TT TW TY UB UD UL UP UR VA Th THE. Oldstyle figures by default; lnum and tnum available.

body.stack: inter-18pt, Inter, 'Inter 18pt', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
body.use: prose and all UI, including labels

mono.stack: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

motion.soft-title: blur 3.8px + opacity 0.55 at rest; 184ms in, 230ms out
motion.scramble: 460ms per character, 26ms stagger, 55ms per card, 0.6x on leave
